info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Open Banking Event-v5-spec
info.description: The Open Banking Event Creation API allows businesses to initiate the creation of open banking events seamlessly. This endpoint is designed to facilitate the efficient submission of event data, which may include transaction details, user authorizations, and financial institution interactions. Typical consumers of this API are financial service providers and application developers aiming to integrate open banking functionalities into their services. By utilizing this API, organizations can enhance their digital banking capabilities and ensure compliance with open banking standards.
